_sources.notes: DrivenByMoss (Jürgen Moßgraber) — Bitwig/Reaper extension supporting Push 1/2/3 natively. Java, LGPL-3.0. Source of truth for MIDI map, SysEx opcodes, palette, ribbon, pad sensitivity, MPE, preamps, pedals. Fichiers clefs: PushControlSurface.java (opcodes 0x03/0x04/0x05/0x06/0x08/0x17/0x1E/0x20/0x26/0x37/0x43), ColorPaletteEntry.java, Push3ControllerDefinition.java.
Reverse-engineering natif Push 3 (framebuffer USB, velocity curves, audio interface, palette indices observés). Seule RE publique Push 3-spécifique identifiée au 2026-04-20.
Ableton User Mode — concept général valable Push 1/2/3. Aucun programmer's reference Push 3 publié au 2026-04-20 (contrairement au repo github.com/Ableton/push-interface qui couvre Push 2).

Sniff firmware 12.x en Standalone mode : 3 heartbeats SysEx observés sur le port MIDI principal — 0x38 0x18 (~3 Hz, 15 bytes payload), 0x38 0x0D (~3 Hz, payload avec compteur 0x3A 0x3B 0x3C), 0x3A 0x21 0xXX (~1.6 Hz, valeur alternant 0x59/0x5A). Ces opcodes n'apparaissent pas dans DrivenByMoss, probablement status firmware interne — exposés ici via /sysex/raw en fallback, non parsés.

End-to-end validation on firmware 12.x, Control Mode via USB-C. Scope tested: pad LED output (/note/on → pad lights in palette colour), button LED output (/cc/<N> → button lights), encoder rotation input (CC 71..78), encoder touch input (note 0..7), button press input (CC 20, 27, 102), pad MPE input (notes on channels 1..15 with CC 74 slide + aftertouch), User Mode toggle SysEx 0x0A 0x01/0x00 (both directions verified by observing behavioural change). Scope NOT tested on hardware: palette entry write/commit (0x03/0x04/0x05), LED/display brightness (0x06/0x08), ribbon mode switch (0x17), pressure mode switch (0x1E), MPE fine-tuning (0x26 sub-opcodes), preamps type/gain (0x37 0x1A/0x1B/0x02/0x03), pedal config (0x37 0x26), audio output routing (0x37 0x11), device inquiry reply (the inquiry was sent, no identity reply observed — Push 3 in Standalone may not answer). Byte layout for untested commands comes verbatim from DrivenByMoss source.

commands._notes: Write one palette entry (RGB + white). Index 0..127. Each channel is 14-bit split into 7-bit LSB+MSB. After writing, call /palette/commit to apply. Source: DrivenByMoss ColorPaletteEntry.java:161-175.
Request one palette entry. Device replies with the 10-byte palette frame on same opcode.
Flush pending palette writes into active pad LED rendering. Source: DrivenByMoss ColorPalette.java:48.
Global LED brightness 0..127. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:930-938 (opcode 0x06).
Display brightness 0..255 split into LSB (low 7 bits) + top bit (bit 7). Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:915-924 (opcode 0x08).
Set touch-strip behaviour. status: 1=volume-fader, 9=discrete, 17=pan, 122=pitch-bend (default). Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:706-737 (opcode 0x17).

Enter/exit User Mode. enable=1 activates User Mode (pads forward their MIDI events to the host, host is responsible for LED feedback). enable=0 exits User Mode (Push 3 handles pad LEDs automatically in response to presses). Opcode 0x0A 0x01 source: danielknng/push3-protocol-docs. Opcode 0x0A 0x00 confirmed via hardware sniff 2026-04-20.
Set pad pressure mode. 0=channel pressure, 1=poly aftertouch, 2=MPE. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:869-875 (opcode 0x1E, Push 3-era).
Per-pad (MPE) pitchbend on/off. enable=0x02 to turn on, 0x00 to turn off. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:958-961 (0x26 0x07 0x08).
MPE in-tune reference point. 0=Pad centre, 1=Finger position. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:969-972 (0x26 0x07 0x0E).
MPE in-tune width (pitch-bend deadzone in mm, spec-controlled). Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:980-983 (0x26 0x07 0x14).
MPE slide height (Y-axis deadzone in mm). Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:991-994 (0x26 0x07 0x24).

Pedal output configuration. value: 0x50=pedal1 footsw + pedal2 footsw (default), 0x43=pedal1 CV + pedal2 footsw, 0x1C=pedal1 footsw + pedal2 CV, 0x0F=both CV. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:1001-1011 (0x37 0x26 + zero padding).
Preamp 1 input type. 0=Line, 1=Instrument, 2=High. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:1017-1022 (0x37 0x1A + zero padding).
Preamp 2 input type. 0=Line, 1=Instrument, 2=High. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:1028-1033 (0x37 0x1B + zero padding).
Preamp 1 digital gain. Range 0x00 (+20 dB) to 0x28 (no gain), step 2 per dB. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:1039-1044 (0x37 0x02 + zero padding).
Preamp 2 digital gain. Range 0x00 (+20 dB) to 0x28 (no gain), step 2 per dB. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:1050-1055 (0x37 0x03 + zero padding).
Output routing. 0=Headphones 1/2 + Speaker 1/2, 2=Headphones 3/4 + Speaker 1/2, 3=Headphones 1/2 + Speaker 3/4. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:1061-1068 (0x37 0x11 + zero padding).

replies._notes: Device identity reply, triggered by Universal Device Inquiry F0 7E 7F 06 01 F7. Source: DrivenByMoss PushControlSurface.java:1267-1292.
